meta.name: paid-ads-optimize
meta.description: Diagnose wasted paid-ad spend, pacing, and allocation, then propose safe evidence-backed optimizations. Use for waste, negatives, budgets, bid changes, poor CPA or ROAS, underpacing, overspend, or scaling decisions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断广告浪费,给出预算、出价与投放节奏的优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在跑付费广告,为花销浪费或转化率不理想发愁
copy.tagline_en: Find wasted ad spend and get safer budget and bid optimization ideas
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage paid ads and worry about wasted spend or poor conversions

howto.what: Claude 会先核对转化信号与归因,判断瓶颈(受众、创意、预算、落地页、跟踪);然后按优先级提可逆调整:排除无关流量→暂停亏损单元→小调预算/出价,并附理由、金额和复查日期。批准后才通过已接入的平台技能执行。
howto.when: 当用户提到广告浪费、否定关键词、预算或出价调整等付费广告问题,或要求改善 CPA/ROAS、扩量/控速时触发。

say.text: 帮我找出广告里浪费的预算,先别动任何设置。
帮我暂停表现最差的广告组,给最好的组加10%预算。
say.note: Claude会给出具体方案等待批准。

say.text: 我的ROAS最近很差,帮我分析原因并给调整建议。
say.note: Claude会按优先级提出可逆优化建议。

howto.what_en: Claude checks conversions/attribution, identifies bottleneck, then proposes reversible fixes: exclude waste, pause losers, adjust budget/bid. It documents rationale and review date; executes after approval via verified connector.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions paid-ad waste, negative keywords, budget or bid changes, poor CPA/ROAS, underspend/overspend, or scaling decisions.

say_en.text: Help me find wasted spend in my Google Ads, don't change anything yet.
say_en.note: Claude runs a diagnosis without making changes.

say_en.text: Pause my worst ad group and increase budget for the best one by 10%.
say_en.note: Claude will propose specific changes for approval.

say_en.text: My ROAS has been poor lately, analyze causes and suggest fixes.
say_en.note: Claude will assess and suggest reversible moves.
